statements.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup (Log4Shell) is not present in any General Bots product
statements.description: CVE-2021-44228 affects Apache Log4j2 2.0-beta9 through 2.15.0. No General Bots product ships Java or Log4j2, so the vulnerable component is not present in any supported configuration.
statements.reason: General Bots Server, the Suite/botui and the desktop client are Rust and TypeScript builds. The SPDX inventory produced by the security workflow contains no Java runtime and no log4j-core package in any edition: SaaS, private cloud or desktop-local. There is therefore no code path in which an attacker-supplied lookup string could reach a Log4j JNDI resolution.
